
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/lwops/p/21568539" title="发布于 2026-07-17 10:08">
    

    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">Lerwee Agentic Ops × WorkBuddy打通感知、分析、执行全链路闭环</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<h1><strong><span style="font-family: Calibri">Lerwee Agentic Ops </span><span style="font-family: 宋体">× </span><span style="font-family: Calibri">WorkBuddy</span><span style="font-family: 宋体">打通感知、分析、执行全链路闭环</span></strong></h1>
<p><span style="font-family: 宋体">当服务器弹出磁盘使用率高达</span> 92% <span style="font-family: 宋体">的严重告警时，放在传统运维模式里，接下来就是一套耗时繁琐的固定流程：</span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: 宋体">运维人员登录堡垒机</span></p>
<p>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;<span style="font-family: Calibri">↓</span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: 宋体">逐条执行磁盘查看命令</span></p>
<p>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;<span style="font-family: Calibri">↓</span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: 宋体">逐层目录排查占用文件</span></p>
<p>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;<span style="font-family: Calibri">↓</span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: 宋体">甄别可清理文件</span></p>
<p>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;<span style="font-family: Calibri">↓ </span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: 宋体">手动执行删除操作；</span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: 宋体">全程耗费大量精力，深夜突发告警更是运维工程师的常态煎熬！</span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: 宋体">但在</span>Lerwee Agentic Ops<span style="font-family: 宋体">联动</span><span style="font-family: Calibri">WorkBuddy</span><span style="font-family: 宋体">的落地场景中，整个故障处置流程彻底被改写，一场磁盘空间超标故障，依靠五层原生架构体系，完成了从告警感知</span><span style="font-family: Calibri">‑</span><span style="font-family: 宋体">根因研判</span><span style="font-family: Calibri">‑</span><span style="font-family: 宋体">方案选择</span><span style="font-family: Calibri">‑</span><span style="font-family: 宋体">自动执行</span><span style="font-family: Calibri">‑</span><span style="font-family: 宋体">事后复盘</span><span style="font-family: Calibri">‑</span><span style="font-family: 宋体">长效优化的完整运维闭环。</span></p>
<p><strong>我拿磁盘爆满的真实场景演示一遍，你就能体会它有多高效。</strong></p>
<p><span style="font-family: 宋体">现在收到一条告警：</span><strong><span style="font-family: 宋体">某服务器分区磁盘使用率高于</span> 90%</strong><span style="font-family: 宋体">，我直接把这条告警交给</span> WorkBuddy <span style="font-family: 宋体">处理。智能体就会自动开展核查工作。</span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: 宋体">首先自动远程登录目标主机，给出告警的诊断报告，如告警等级、状态等</span></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1549131/202607/1549131-20260717095219675-610511293.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong><span style="font-family: 微软雅黑">紧接着</span> AI 进一步做目录占用和文件粒度的根因剖析：</strong></p>
<p><span style="font-family: 宋体">获取磁盘分区整体情况：分区总容量</span> 7.5G<span style="font-family: 宋体">，已使用 </span><span style="font-family: Calibri">6.8G</span><span style="font-family: 宋体">，磁盘使用率高达 </span><span style="font-family: Calibri">92%</span><span style="font-family: 宋体">，判定</span><strong><span style="font-family: 宋体">故障属实并非误报</span></strong><span style="font-family: 宋体">；</span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: 宋体">接着执行目录占用统计，识别出</span> /usr<span style="font-family: 宋体">、</span><span style="font-family: Calibri">/opt</span><span style="font-family: 宋体">、</span><span style="font-family: Calibri">/var</span><span style="font-family: 宋体">、</span><span style="font-family: Calibri">/home </span><span style="font-family: 宋体">是磁盘占用大户，梳理清楚整体占用概况。</span></p>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1549131/202607/1549131-20260717095235563-1073518596.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>分析完成之后，会给出可落地的自愈方案。</strong></p>
<p><strong><span style="font-family: 微软雅黑">方案</span> 1：一键快速清理。</strong></p>
<p><span style="font-family: 宋体">智能体编排安全脚本，自动清理</span> /tmp <span style="font-family: 宋体">过期临时文件、老旧日志、软件包缓存；同时检索大于 </span><span style="font-family: Calibri">100M </span><span style="font-family: 宋体">的文件交由运维人员复核；</span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: 宋体">清理完毕之后回采磁盘状态，把磁盘使用率降到安全阈值，</span><strong><span style="font-family: 宋体">全程可以一键执行</span></strong><span style="font-family: 宋体">。</span></p>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1549131/202607/1549131-20260717095302679-1546781190.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong><span style="font-family: 微软雅黑">方案</span> 2：按需深度排查。</strong></p>
<p><span style="font-family: 宋体">如果你想区分可清理临时文件和系统核心程序文件，既可以快速释放磁盘空间，又能够防止误删关键文件引发业务故障，</span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: 宋体">可以让</span> AI <span style="font-family: 宋体">继续逐层分析 </span><span style="font-family: Calibri">/var </span><span style="font-family: 宋体">和 </span><span style="font-family: Calibri">/home </span><span style="font-family: 宋体">目录，列出深层文件清单；</span></p>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1549131/202607/1549131-20260717095330136-1171702630.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>确认执行，即可完成故障恢复</strong></p>
<p><span style="font-family: 宋体">运维确认执行清理操作后，</span>WorkBuddy <span style="font-family: 宋体">将会调用</span><span style="font-family: Calibri">Lerwee Agentic Ops</span><span style="font-family: 宋体">的自动化运维功能执行先前生成好的安全清理脚本，并且输出清晰的清理前后数据对比。</span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: 宋体">磁盘指标回落至安全范围，这条磁盘使用率过高的告警自动解除。</span></p>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1549131/202607/1549131-20260717095348059-1867674482.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>最后，还会给出输出长期优化方案</strong></p>
<p><span style="font-family: 宋体">磁盘紧急问题处理完毕后，不只解决当下告警，还会给出长效优化建议，从根源降低故障复发概率。</span></p>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1549131/202607/1549131-20260717095400145-676668243.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>&nbsp;<span style="font-family: 微软雅黑">不只是排障，</span>Agentic Ops底层加持，造就硬核 AI运维能力。</strong></p>
<p><span style="font-family: 宋体">单次磁盘故障自愈只是缩影，</span>Lerwee Agentic Ops <span style="font-family: 宋体">给 </span><span style="font-family: Calibri">WorkBuddy </span><span style="font-family: 宋体">筑牢五层底层架构，把数据采集、资产管理、业务、知识库、自动化执行融为一体。</span></p>
<p>● <span style="font-family: 宋体">底层完整运维闭环：感知</span>-<span style="font-family: 宋体">记忆</span><span style="font-family: Calibri">-</span><span style="font-family: 宋体">规划</span><span style="font-family: Calibri">-</span><span style="font-family: 宋体">行动</span><span style="font-family: Calibri">-</span><span style="font-family: 宋体">大脑 五层原生架构，内置 </span><span style="font-family: Calibri">Perseus </span><span style="font-family: 宋体">全域采集、</span><span style="font-family: Calibri">CMDB </span><span style="font-family: 宋体">资产、监控 </span><span style="font-family: Calibri">/ </span><span style="font-family: 宋体">日志 </span><span style="font-family: Calibri">/ APM</span><span style="font-family: 宋体">、</span><span style="font-family: Calibri">Lerwee Claw </span><span style="font-family: 宋体">自动化执行引擎，具备专业运维领域知识图谱、故障根因 </span><span style="font-family: Calibri">RCA</span><span style="font-family: 宋体">、告警收敛、业务拓扑分析、变更管控原生能力。</span></p>
<p>● <span style="font-family: 宋体">数据可信底座：掌握全栈</span> IT <span style="font-family: 宋体">原始指标、日志、资产拓扑、历史故障工单、处置脚本，为上层交互提供可溯源、可执行、符合运维规范的专业结论，解决通用大模型运维幻觉问题。</span></p>
<p>&nbsp;● <span style="font-family: 宋体">执行权限闭环：可直接驱动重启、扩容、配置变更、巡检、工单派发、自愈操作，拥有企业</span> IT <span style="font-family: 宋体">系统完整操作权限域。</span></p>
<p>&nbsp;● <span style="font-family: 宋体">多端统一入口：钉钉</span> / <span style="font-family: 宋体">飞书 </span><span style="font-family: Calibri">/ </span><span style="font-family: 宋体">企业微信全通讯渠道原生接入，运维人员无需登录运维大屏，聊天窗口自然语言下发指令、接收告警、查看报告。</span></p>
<p>&nbsp;● <span style="font-family: 宋体">多</span> Agent <span style="font-family: 宋体">任务编排：支持拆解复杂运维需求，创建巡检、报表、变更稽核、复盘文档子智能体组队协作，调度乐维智能体完成批量、周期性复合任务。</span></p>
<p>&nbsp;● <span style="font-family: 宋体">长时记忆</span> + <span style="font-family: 宋体">主动推送：沉淀运维人员交互习惯、常用业务范围、值班排班，定时自动拉取乐维数据生成日报 </span><span style="font-family: Calibri">/ </span><span style="font-family: 宋体">周报 </span><span style="font-family: Calibri">/ </span><span style="font-family: 宋体">故障复盘并推送；记忆跨渠道互通，全会话上下文连贯。</span></p>
<p>&nbsp;● <span style="font-family: 宋体">通用办公技能补位：内置</span> Office <span style="font-family: 宋体">文档解析、报表生成、</span><span style="font-family: Calibri">PDF </span><span style="font-family: 宋体">复盘、数据摘要能力，把运维原始输出转化为可对外交付的标准化材料。</span></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
